programs.title: Polar Worlds with Bertie Gregory Mashup
programs.desc: Traveler and filmmaker Bertie Gregory journeys to the poles to film wildlife in two of the harshest environments on the planet: the island of South Georgia in Antarctica and the frigid North Canada in the Arctic.You will see how the animals that inhabit these harsh areas cope and how global warming affects their habitats.You will see scenes from the lives of king and golden-crested penguins, sea lions, southern whales and petrels, as well as polar bears and wolves.Surviving in these extremely different environments requires cunning and perseverance.

programs.title: Animal Fight Club
programs.desc: There is a constant struggle in the animal kingdom.Lions, elephants, polar bears and cobras engage in deadly fights.The cameras capture scenes full of tension, drama and determination.Each fight has a story behind it.An alligator boldly wanting to assert its dominance, a hungry bear fighting for food, or a fox taking part in a mating ritual - they will show their capabilities.Unique recordings show the colorful and cruel world of animals.Tactics, hidden weapons, deception - wild creatures use all possibilities and will stop at nothing to survive.

programs.title: Wild Hawaii
programs.desc: Hawaii was formed seven million years ago when it emerged from the sea.Initially, it was a volcanic wasteland, now it is considered an earthly paradise.Such a change is contrary to the laws of nature, and yet Hawaii is a wild Arcadia that is constantly transformed and influenced by numerous influences.Thanks to factors such as separation from the mainland, differences in altitude and tropical climate, the islands have developed an extremely rich flora and fauna, including species threatened with extinction;in fact, there are most of them here.

programs.title: Yellowstone Wolf Dynasty
programs.desc: The history of a controversial natural experiment - the reintroduction of wolves in Yellowstone and the history of this species in the USA.Plus, a behind-the-scenes look at the process by which the predators returned to the park.

programs.title: China's Wild Empire
programs.desc: China, one of the most populous countries in the world, is also the country with the highest biodiversity in the world outside the tropics.Dense forests, steep mountains, swamps and deserts are conditions conducive to the development of amazing animal species.The creators go to unknown places in China to see the richness of nature in this region of the Earth.They will learn about, among others, golden roxelans.These animals fight for food, mates and position in the herd.To survive, they face challenges such as weather, lack of food and the threat of predators.

programs.title: Animals Gone Wild
programs.desc: The program presents the most extraordinary moments from the lives of animals.Viewers will see both suspenseful and shocking footage.
